text:
maria: Heads up — after the 22:00 UTC deploy we saw a p95 regression on the EU embeddings route. Deploybot suggested a soft rollback. Can we triage?

deploybot: [AUTOMATION] Suggestion: soft rollback to v3.9.1 for eu-embeddings-route. Trigger: p95 >= 100ms above baseline for 3m. Recommended action: traffic split 20% -> 0% over 5m. Run `/rollout status 4087654321` to inspect.

ash: grabbing traces now. which canary slice hit it?

maria: canary slice eu-1 (10%) and staging eu-2 (5%) both saw the spike. Quick metric snapshot:
```
metric: embeddings.p95.eu = baseline 180ms -> now 300ms
error rate: unchanged
cpu: short spike on pod gpu-13
```

sam: Is the regression only on the quantized variant? We merged a kernel change in the runtime yesterday.

vicky: I noticed the kernel flag toggle on eu nodes in the deploy: `enable_async_kv = true` was flipped.

john: Proposal: manual, staged rollback. Steps:
1) Pin eu-embeddings to v3.9.1
2) Shift traffic from suspect variant 20% -> 0% over 10m
3) Watch p95 and kv cache hit rate during the shift

maria: ops — can you run the pin? @ops-team @deploybot

deploybot: ack. Executing: `/pin-service eu-embeddings v3.9.1 --reason "p95 regression post-deploy" --by maria`

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042, assigned to @ash

ash: confirmed kernel flag is the likely suspect. I'll patch a staging node back to the previous flag and validate. ETA ~15m.

cust-success-anna: If we rollback we'll need a customer-facing line. My suggestion: 'We detected a performance regression affecting embeddings in EU after today's deploy and are reverting to the previous stable variant to restore latency. No customer data was affected.' Thoughts?

sam: LGTM — safe, clear.

maria: +1 to that copy. Also post-mortem action: add an explicit canary gate for `enable_async_kv` toggles.

vicky: I'll open the follow-up ticket and add the gate to the release checklist.

ash: rolling the pin in staging now. If staging p95 improves we'll apply the same pin in prod.

deploybot: Rollout started: traffic-split plan initiated. Monitor: #ops-alerts.

maria: Thanks. Keep updates short. Ping when eu.p95 is back under threshold for 5m and we'll close INC-2026-042. :thumbsup:
